### Delete an automation

`DELETE /agents/repos/{owner}/{repo}/automations/{automation_id}` · operationId `agent-automations/delete-repo-automation` · [docs](https://docs.github.com/rest/agent-automations/agent-automations#delete-an-automation)

- Responses: `204` · `400`: application/json object · `401`: application/json object · `404`: application/json object · `503`: application/json object

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `owner` | path | string | yes |  |  |
| `repo` | path | string | yes |  |  |
| `automation_id` | path | string | yes |  |  |

### List revisions for an automation

`GET /agents/repos/{owner}/{repo}/automations/{automation_id}/revisions` · operationId `agent-automations/list-automation-revisions` · [docs](https://docs.github.com/rest/agent-automations/agent-automations#list-revisions-for-an-automation)

- Paging: `per_page` + cursor-based (`cursor`); items in `revisions`; `Link` header
- Responses: `200`: application/json object (headers: `Link`) · `400`: application/json object · `401`: application/json object · `404`: application/json object

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `owner` | path | string | yes |  |  |
| `repo` | path | string | yes |  |  |
| `automation_id` | path | string | yes |  |  |
| `cursor` | query | string |  |  |  |
| `per_page` | query | integer |  | `30` | min `1`; max `100` |

### List tasks for an automation in a repository

`GET /agents/repos/{owner}/{repo}/automations/{automation_id}/tasks` · operationId `agent-automations/list-repo-automation-tasks` · [docs](https://docs.github.com/rest/agent-automations/agent-automations#list-tasks-for-an-automation-in-a-repository)

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `owner` | path | string | yes |  |  |
| `repo` | path | string | yes |  |  |
| `automation_id` | path | string | yes |  |  |
| `per_page` | query | integer |  | `30` | min `1`; max `100` |
| `page` | query | integer |  | `1` | min `1` |
| `sort` | query | string |  | `updated_at` | one of: `updated_at`, `created_at` |
| `direction` | query | string |  | `desc` | one of: `asc`, `desc` |
| `state` | query | string |  |  |  |
| `is_archived` | query | boolean |  | `false` |  |

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `owner` | path | string | yes |  |  |
| `repo` | path | string | yes |  |  |

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
